title: Restreamed server + tooling for Streamline
author: Pale-Professor
selftext:
Streamline (Proletariat, 2016) is a 16-player arena game whose official servers went dark in April 2018. Restreamed is a from-scratch reimplementation of the client's backend protocol and a set of tools for working with your own copy of the game.

Why? I bought it and never got to play it. A local server now gets through login and into the HOME menu, offline practice/challenge/tutorial all work, and a listen server boots the map and listens on 7777. Multiplayer is still broken.

If you’ve got the game, install it and tell me what breaks, or contribute if you can.

[https://github.com/Lakeland97/restreamed](https://github.com/Lakeland97/restreamed)
